memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Rheumatoid arthritis
  - Status: Active, morning stiffness 45 min, joint swelling in MCP and PIP joints, tender.
  - Plan: Continue methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD. Add NSAID as needed. Weight 62 kg, waist 78 cm (<80 cm cut‑off). Diet: Breakfast – low‑sugar, high‑fiber; Lunch – balanced with vegetables; Dinner – light, avoid fried foods.
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure‑free on current regimen, no adverse effects.
  - Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD. Check serum sodium and creatinine annually.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Bloating and occasional diarrhea, triggered by spicy food.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS. Avoid trigger foods, increase soluble fiber.
Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: X‑ray hands (PA): Soft tissue swelling noted around MCP joints. No erosions seen. Joint spaces preserved. No bony destruction.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more stiffness in my fingers in the mornings, especially after weekends. My stomach feels bloated after eating spicy curry, and I had a brief episode of loose stool yesterday. No seizures lately.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-10 at 10:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (Endocrinology).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Rheumatoid arthritis
  - Status: Improved, morning stiffness reduced to 20 min, less swelling, patient reports better function.
  - Plan: Continue current DMARDs. Consider tapering prednisolone to 2.5 mg OD after 4 weeks if symptoms remain stable. Weight 61.5 kg, waist 77 cm (<80 cm). Diet: Breakfast – oats with fruit; Lunch – dal‑rice with veg; Dinner – chapati‑veg, limit oil.
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure‑free, no side‑effects.
  - Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD. Check serum sodium & creatinine in 6 months.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Bloating decreased after avoiding spicy food, occasional loose stool.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide PRN. Add probiotic trial.
Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: EEG: Awake and sleep recordings show no epileptiform discharges. Background activity normal for age. No focal slowing. Interpretation: No evidence of epileptiform activity; consistent with clinical seizure‑free status.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Neurology, Dr S. Rao, for review of epilepsy management and consideration of possible medication taper given prolonged seizure‑free period. Include recent EEG report and medication list.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurology opinion: Patient remains seizure‑free on levetiracetam 500 mg BD and lamotrigine 50 mg BD. EEG normal. Recommend continuation of current regimen; no taper advised at present. Follow‑up in 6 months or earlier if seizures recur.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve had more abdominal discomfort lately – crampy pain after meals, alternating constipation and diarrhea. My joints feel okay, morning stiffness minimal. No seizures. I’ve been avoiding dairy and gluten‑rich foods, which seems to help the bloating.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Rheumatoid arthritis
  - Status: Stable, morning stiffness <10 min, no new joint tenderness.
  - Plan: Continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 2.5 mg OD. Monitor LFTs q3months. Weight 61 kg, waist 76 cm (<80 cm). Diet: Breakfast – idli with sambar; Lunch – vegetable‑rice; Dinner – roti‑legume, avoid deep‑fried.
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure‑free >18 months, meds well tolerated.
  - Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD. Check serum sodium & creatinine annually.
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Symptom‑controlled with diet modification, occasional mild bloating.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide PRN. Consider low‑FODMAP trial if symptoms worsen.
Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
